title: Croatian Spring Pasta Bake
description: A light and flavorful Italian-inspired pasta bake with Croatian spring flavors.

ingredients.name: zesty croatian olive oil
ingredients.notes: for cooking pasta and adding flavor

instructions: Cook spring pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp zesty croatian olive oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chopped spring onions and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Combine cooked pasta, garlic-onion mixture, and 1 cup grated romano cheese in a large bowl.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish and drizzle with remaining 1 tbsp zesty croatian olive oil.
Top with additional grated romano cheese and bake for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
